method: Fresh full semantic reading of all 38 assigned tooling, test, workflow, root documentation and configuration files. Reviewed source inventory exclusions, immutable historical classifications without inspecting old implementation, exact-change test selection, Python per-case collection, authorization binding, CI root-copy identity and platform reconciliation, independent native package integrity, isolated environments, Windows controller diagnostics and cleanup. All nine tooling tests and native-env fixture read in full, including embedded executable fixtures. Read complete architecture, feature boundaries, historical problem acceptance and user README; unpublished commands are explicitly distinguished from the existing immutable release tag. pnpm-lock.yaml and 21 verification/feature-evidence files are separately assigned to the tooling-data reviewer and are not claimed here. This static review ran no tests and does not assert public ACME acceptance or current CI execution.
